base_us: Fusion Master-extended B306 TIMER2 time at first TWIM pull initiation
delta_us: unsigned offset from batch base in B306 1 MHz TIMER2
host_timestamp: host monotonic/wall receipt; boundary and infrastructure diagnostic
master_ms: Fusion Master k_uptime_get() at BLE notification callback; receipt diagnostic

uwb.cfo_ppm_q8: signed ppm in Q8 fixed point
uwb.poll_tx: DWM1001 DW1000 little-endian 40-bit broadcast poll TX timestamp
uwb.sweep: uint32 monotonic modulo wrap, pairs UART frame with strobe
uwb.t_round_us: measured responder RX minus broadcast poll TX, microseconds
